| colspan="7" align="left" style="width:50px"| '''Notes:'''{{refbegin}}
{{note|necklace|<small>1</small>}}<small> An Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|bonus|<small>2</small>}}<small> Tokalo won an additional reward for having two of its members as the last two people standing in the challenge.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>3</small>}}<small> At the ambassadors meeting, the two ambassadors agreed to vote Marie-France out of the game.</small><br />
{{note|jury|<small>4</small>}} <small> Marie-France was evacuated from the jury for personal reasons.</small><br />
{{note|suddendeath|<small>5</small>}}<small> The castaway who came in last in the individual Immunity Challenge was eliminated from the game.</small><br />
{{note|tieddestinies|<small>6</small>}}<small> Alix was Laurent's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when Laurent was voted out.</small><br />
{{note|finalfive|<small>7</small>}} <small> At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge where two castaways would be eliminated from the game. Dorian and Lola came in last and were eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
